slicingContext: the game is a single inline <script> that is one top-level IIFE — slices descend one level into the IIFE body and cut at ITS top-level statement boundaries; the wrapper head/tail and the two early-return guard statements (not standalone) are skipped sections
note: SEEDWORLD (https://openbench.fun/seedworld/) is capture-class: a single-document WebGL game on the Openbench platform served under the /seedworld/ sub-path — the entire game (raw WebGL renderer, GLSL shaders, 2D-canvas solar system, GPU texture baker, in-browser ZIP encoder) lives in one inline <script> block of seedworld/index.html, and the whole UI stylesheet in one inline <style> block; no captured .js or .css file exists and the only external <link> is Google Fonts CSS, a CDN dependency that stays CDN (PLAN §1, socker precedent — never backfilled). §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-13 — no public upstream repo exists (openbench.fun publishes deployments, not sources), so the mirror stands. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, single pass verified idempotent — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/: the inline script to index-inline-1.pretty.js and the inline stylesheet to index-inline-1.pretty.css (capture-root-relative twin names with the seedworld/ prefix stripped; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/index-inline-1-NN.js cut at the IIFE body's top-level statement boundaries (~250-350 line windows; oversized single declarations stay whole) with an exact 2-line provenance header. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range. Non-standalone parts are skipped sections, indexed but never sliced: the IIFE wrapper head (the `(function(){` line plus the `"use strict";` directive prologue) and tail (`})();`), and the two early-return guard statements (`if(!gl){…return;}` / `if(!prog){…return;}` — a bare `return` is illegal outside a function). Stylesheet rule — the inline <style> block is wholeFile, never sliced. The entry script is authored source, NOT minified — identifiers are the game's own names, so the identifier-rename campaign (PLAN §5) does not apply to this mirror. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
